title: SignalR: Real-Time Updates and Backplanes | Orchard Core
description:
Pages that update while they are open need a connection between the browser and the server, and that connection has to keep working when a site runs on more than one instance.

The Orchard Core SignalR module registers SignalR once for the tenant and provides the JavaScript client as a named resource. The Redis and Azure backplane modules relay hub messages between instances. The Media Library and the Workflows hub show how a module uses it.

In this video:
• Why the SignalR module exists and what it provides
• The SignalR, SignalR Redis Backplane and SignalR Azure Backplane features
• A hub at work: the Media Library updating in a second tab
• Hosting a hub in your own module
• Sending messages from the server to a group of clients
• Connecting from the browser with the signalr resource
• Scaling out with the Redis and Azure backplanes
